summary: Practise Python model building, validation and clustering with scikit-learn. Review the five-day course outline and choose your next step.
lede: Supervised and unsupervised learning help analysts prepare data and evaluate models for analytical decisions. For data analysts, machine-learning practitioners and technical professionals with basic Python experience, the course covers pandas preparation, leakage-aware data splitting, classification and regression evaluation, and cross-validation. Learners also use K-means or DBSCAN to explore clusters and communicate model limits and findings to decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is for you if your work involves preparing analytical data, testing machine-learning approaches or translating model results into decisions. It suits professionals with basic Python familiarity who want to practise reproducible workflows rather than study algorithms in isolation.
prerequisites: Basic Python familiarity and experience working with tabular data are expected. Coding is required for the practical exercises; you will use Python, pandas and scikit-learn in notebook-based labs.
